```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pval in h.PURPOSES:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    dd = h.filter_by_purpose(dmps, pval)
    import pandas as pd
    rows = []
    for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
        sub = h.filter_department(dd, dept)
        rev = h.revision_distribution(sub)
        for _, r in rev.iterrows():
            rows.append({"Department": dept, "Revisions": r["Revisions"], "DMPs": r["DMPs"]})
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="Revisions", y="DMPs", color="Department",
                 barmode="group", height=450,
                 title="Revision distribution by department")
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('</div>')
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pval in h.PURPOSES:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    dd = h.filter_by_purpose(dmps, pval)
    import pandas as pd
    rows = []
    for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
        sub = h.filter_department(dd, dept)
        s = h.days_to_first_submission(sub).dropna()
        if len(s):
            rows.append({"Department": dept, "Median days": s.median()})
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="Department", y="Median days",
                 text=df["Median days"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.0f}"),
                 color="Department", height=450,
                 title="Median days to first submission by department")
    fig.update_layout(showlegend=False)
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('</div>')
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
for pkey, pval in h.PURPOSES:
    act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
    print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
    dd = h.filter_by_purpose(dmps, pval)
    import pandas as pd
    rows = []
    for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
        sub = h.filter_department(dd, dept)
```
```{python}
        hr = h.help_needed_rate(sub)
        combined = hr[hr["Field"] == "Any field (combined)"]
        if len(combined):
            rows.append({"Department": dept, "Rate": combined.iloc[0]["Rate"]})
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    fig = px.bar(df, x="Department", y="Rate",
                 text=df["Rate"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.1%}"),
                 color="Department", height=450,
                 title="'I need advice' rate by department")
    fig.update_layout(yaxis_tickformat="0%", showlegend=False)
    print(h.render_chart(fig))
    print('</div>')
```

```{python}
#| tags: [hide-all]
#| output: asis
for dept in h.DEPARTMENTS:
    slug = h.DEPT_SLUGS[dept]
    dd_all = dept_data[dept]
    print(f'<div class="dept-panel" id="dept-{slug}" style="display:none">')

    for pkey, pval in h.PURPOSES:
        act = " purpose-active" if pkey == "all" else ""
        print(f'<div class="purpose-content{act}" data-purpose="{pkey}">')
        dd = h.filter_by_purpose(dd_all, pval)
        print(h.kpi_html(dd))

        df = h.revision_distribution(dd)
        fig = px.bar(df, x="Revisions", y="DMPs", text="DMPs", color="DMPs")
        fig.update_layout(showlegend=False, height=450)
        print(h.render_chart(fig))

        s = h.days_to_first_submission(dd).dropna()
        fig = px.histogram(s, nbins=40, labels={"value": "Days"})
        fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="Days", yaxis_title="DMPs", height=450, showlegend=False,
                          annotations=[dict(text=f"Median: {s.median():.0f} days | Mean: {s.mean():.1f} days",
                          xref="paper", x=0.98, yref="paper", y=0.98, xanchor="right", showarrow=False)])
        print(h.render_chart(fig))

        s = h.first_response_time(dd).dropna()
        fig = px.histogram(s, nbins=40, labels={"value": "Days"})
        fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="Days", yaxis_title="DMPs", height=450, showlegend=False,
                          annotations=[dict(text=f"Median: {s.median():.0f} days | Mean: {s.mean():.1f} days",
                          xref="paper", x=0.98, yref="paper", y=0.98, xanchor="right", showarrow=False)])
        print(h.render_chart(fig))

        df = h.help_needed_rate(dd)
        fig = px.bar(df, x="Field", y="Rate", text=df["Rate"].map(lambda v: f"{v:.1%}"), color="Field")
        fig.update_layout(yaxis_tickformat="0%", showlegend=False, height=450)
        print(h.render_chart(fig))

        print('</div>')
    print('</div>')
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var sel = document.getElementById("dept-select");
  var panels = document.querySelectorAll(".dept-panel");
  function show(slug) {
    panels.forEach(function (p) { p.style.display = "none"; });
    var target = document.getElementById("dept-" + slug);
    if (target) target.style.display = "";
  }
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var init = params.get("dept");
  if (init) { sel.value = init; show(init); }
  else { show(sel.value); }
  sel.addEventListener("change", function () {
    show(this.value);
    params.set("dept", this.value);
    history.replaceState(null, "", "?" + params.toString());
  });

  var purposeToggle = document.querySelector(".purpose-toggle");
  if (purposeToggle) {
    var pBtns = purposeToggle.querySelectorAll(".purpose-btn");
    var pPanels = document.querySelectorAll(".purpose-content");
    function showPurpose(p) {
      pBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.purpose === p); });
      pPanels.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.toggle("purpose-active", el.dataset.purpose === p); });
    }
    pBtns.forEach(function (b) { b.addEventListener("click", function () { showPurpose(this.dataset.purpose); }); });
    showPurpose("all");
  }
});
</script>
